lessons_used: Predictions frequently overestimated positive impact overall, but underestimated strong wins.
Home wait_info changes can be helpful (4 winning tests in rounds 3, 4, 7, and 9), though 7 tests showed no clear effect.
Sign-in hint changes can be helpful (3 winning tests in rounds 4, 6, and 15), though 10 tests showed no clear effect.
Sign-in reorder and adoption new_flow changes proved consistently harmful across agreeing tests.
Choose_path layout, finish copy, and home notification changes showed no clear effect across agreeing tests.
Evidence remains thin or inconsistent for adoption redesign, finish new_flow, finish new_screen, choose_path copy, choose_path redesign, adoption hint, and single-test categories.

candidates.title: Dual Column Pet Profile Adoption Certificate
candidates.change: Redesigns the adoption certificate into a dual-column profile layout showcasing pet personality traits and attributes.
candidates.why: The adoption step has a 66.2% conversion rate and takes a median of 89s; a clean dual-column profile helps users finalize choices quickly.

adoption_certificate.headline: Desktop Pet Profile Summary
adoption_certificate.body: Review your companion's traits before bringing them to your desktop environment.

guard.reason: 'adoption_certificate.components[0].asset' must be a bundled onboarding asset id (asset:...)

candidates.title: Desktop Control Overview Spotlight Screen
candidates.change: Adds a dedicated spotlight screen before home welcome explaining keyboard shortcuts and system tray controls.
candidates.why: Multiple support emails reported user confusion on how to control, hide, or bring back the pet after onboarding.

new_desktop_controls_spotlight.headline: Master Desktop Pet Controls
new_desktop_controls_spotlight.body: Learn how to access, hide, and interact with your companion anytime using taskbar tray controls.

components.text: Press Alt+P anytime to switch desktop pet overlay mode.

guard.reason: Adds a new spotlight screen within onboarding while keeping all required steps and screen functions intact.

candidates.score_note: Finish step loses 21.3% of users, but historical data shows finish new_screen changes average -0.7% across 7 tests.

candidates.title: Sign-In Existing Account Pet History Hint
candidates.change: Adds a clear hint on the sign-in screen explaining that logging in restores previously saved pets and settings.
candidates.why: 8 support emails were received about pets missing or reset after signing in again.

sign_in.hint: Signing in with your existing account restores your saved desktop pets and preferences automatically.

guard.reason: Adds a helpful sign-in hint within onboarding without altering core required features or pricing.

candidates.score_note: Sign-in hints are low-cost text updates with proven positive history (+1.6% avg, 3 winning tests) backed by support emails.

candidates.title: Path Selection Story Scroll Stage
candidates.change: Redesigns the path selection screen into a vertical story-scroll layout highlighting setup time and pet options.
candidates.why: Choose path drops 20.4% of users and has a mean time of 514s; story scroll layout improves engagement.

choose_path.headline: Select Your Onboarding Journey
choose_path.body: Pick between quick instant adoption or creating a custom desktop companion.

guard.reason: Redesigns path selection layout while retaining both path options and the screen's core functionality.

candidates.score_note: Choose_path drops 20.4%, but choose_path redesigns historically perform poorly (-2.2% across 2 tests) and carry high dev cost.

candidates.title: Desktop Render Activity Progress Status Bar
candidates.change: Updates the render waiting screen with a status bar and live estimated remaining time indicator.
candidates.why: Home wait step has a high median duration of 201s and mean of 2336s; progress updates keep users informed.

waiting.headline: Preparing Your Pet Desktop Workspace
waiting.body: Generating companion animations and setting up tray controls.

guard.reason: Adds a progress bar and estimate for a real waiting process, which is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Home wait_info changes consistently help (+1.0% avg across 11 tests, 4 winners) by addressing long render wait times.

candidates.title: Interactive Custom Pet Photo Preview Flow
candidates.change: Inserts an interactive photo preview check screen allowing users to verify uploaded photos before generation.
candidates.why: Support received tickets regarding custom pet creation failing or looking wrong.

new_photo_preview_stage.headline: Review Pet Visual Preview
new_photo_preview_stage.body: Confirm lighting and visual framing before initiating desktop generation.

guard.reason: Inserts a new preview screen inside onboarding while keeping all required steps in order.

candidates.score_note: Adoption step drops 33.8% of users, but adoption new_flow additions are consistently harmful (-5.5% avg across tests).

candidates.title: Taskbar and Pet Visibility Welcome Copy
candidates.change: Updates the home welcome text to explicitly state how to unhide the pet from the system tray.
candidates.why: Support tickets showed post-onboarding confusion regarding how to find or show hidden pets.

home_intro.headline: Your Companion is Live on Your Desktop!
home_intro.body: If your pet disappears, click the tray icon in your taskbar or press Alt+P to toggle visibility.

guard.reason: Updates home intro copy within onboarding without affecting outside screens or core rules.

candidates.score_note: Config/copy change is cheap, but finish copy edits historically showed slight negative impact (-1.8%).

candidates.title: Photo Upload Rendering Guidance Hint
candidates.change: Adds a hint banner on the photo upload screen explaining photo quality standards for accurate rendering.
candidates.why: Addressing support issues with failed custom pet generations due to photo input quality.

upload_photos.hint: For crisp desktop pet visuals, use clear, well-lit photos with a centered subject.

guard.reason: Adds helpful guidance copy to photo upload screen inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Targets the highest drop-off step (adoption, 33.8% drop) cheaply, but adoption hint evidence remains thin and slightly negative (-1.2%).

candidates.title: Desktop Spawn Background Completion Notification
candidates.change: Enables desktop background notifications when pet generation completes while the app is minimized.
candidates.why: Long mean render wait time (2336s) causes users to leave without knowing setup finished.

waiting.hint: Feel free to minimize this window. We'll alert you as soon as your pet arrives on screen.

guard.reason: Adds completion notification setting to waiting screen during real waiting period.

candidates.score_note: Addresses long render wait times (2336s mean), but home notification changes show no clear strong effect (+0.6% avg).

candidates.title: Starter Pet Desk Toy Bonus Badge
candidates.change: Adds an exclusive starter bonus badge on path option cards to encourage fast path selection.
candidates.why: Drop-off at path selection is 20.4%; adding explicit starter bonuses increases conversion.

guard.reason: Onboarding copy mentions gifts, bonuses, or free extras ('Includes Starter Desk Accessory').
